title: Transient tranfection of unicellular relative of animals,  Creolimax fragrantissima, using Lonza Nucleofector
author: Aleksandra Kozyczkowska

steps_raw.instruction: Start a culture two days before transfection to get the culture full of amoebas cells 300ul of culture + 9ml of Marine Broth in a 25cm2 flask

steps_raw.title: Count the cells to reach 1.5E6 cells / condition
steps_raw.instruction: If there are more conditions, it is recommended to pull the cells together to get more visible pellet

steps_raw.title: Add 20ul of P3 buffer (Lonza) / condition
steps_raw.instruction: P3 PrimaryCell 4D-Nucleofector Kit S (32 rxn) Kit Catalog# H3V4XP-5032 It is recommended not to keep the cells in P3 buffer for too long

steps_raw.title: Add 1-3 ug of a circular plasmid / condition
steps_raw.instruction: Our plasmid contains sequence coding H2B-Venus under tubulin promoter It is recommended to have a highly concentrated plasmid

steps_raw.title: Transfer cells + DNA into a well
steps_raw.instruction: Carefully & without creating bubbles In total 20-22ul
Insert into a Lonza machine and apply a code: EN-138

steps_raw.title: Immediatelly add 80ul of Marine Broth medium (MB) to a well

steps_raw.instruction: Transfer to 1ml of growth medium in 12-well plate (NUNC) and incubate overnight

steps_raw.title: Check for positive cells 24h later using fluorescent microscopy
